segments.name: CaaS
segments.description: Provides its technology platform and program management to bank partners that originate private label and general purpose credit cards for underserved consumers.
segments.evidence: These products include private label credit cards using the Fortiva and Curae brand names as well as merchant associated brands.

segments.name: Auto Finance
segments.description: Purchases and services loans secured by automobiles and provides floor plan financing to independent used-car dealers and automotive finance companies.
segments.evidence: Within our Auto Finance segment, our CAR subsidiary operations principally purchase and/or service loans secured by automobiles from or for, and also provide floor plan financing for, a pre-qualified network of independent automotive dealers and automotive finance companies in the buy-here, pay-here, used car business.

revenueModel.text: Lenders, including our bank partners, pay us fees and sell us the receivables their cards and loans generate; consumers pay finance charges and fees.
revenueModel.evidence: These lenders pay us a fee and in most circumstances, the lenders are then obligated to sell us the receivables they generate from these products and services.
